protocol.purpose: Input-corrected conditional following on one road section and observed queue release; v1 observations are released development evidence.
protocol.selection: Fixed fresh first-session blocks, numeric vehicle identity order, at most one per kind/block. Exclude every (global_time-100*frame_id, vehicle_id) identity exposed in either v1 stage, including candidate snapshots and rejected trajectories. No model error enters eligibility.

rules: Remove exact duplicates, reject conflicting subject/time rows, truncation, missing 100 ms samples and nonconsecutive frame IDs.
Every subject remains a northbound through passenger Car in one unchanged lane; every follower retains its recorded immediate leader throughout initialization and prediction.
Use front-center local_y and measured lengths, converted from feet. Reject nonfinite data, negative annotated speeds, reversed steps beyond tolerance or overlapping observed bumpers.
Initialize speed by least-squares position slope over the disjoint one-second prefix; head-leader velocity at each boundary uses only its previous one-second positions, floored at zero.

Queue prefix fitted speed must remain within the stop threshold for all three Cars. The fixed virtual discharge station is 5 m beyond the head leader's initial front. All observed subjects must cross within 20 seconds; missing predicted crossings fail coverage, never exclude the case.
Retain all raw responses, query URLs, SHA256, license and every rejection. No fitted time shifts, post-outcome filtering or traffic-coefficient calibration.

baselines: Constant velocity from the initialization prefix
Rigid initial bumper spacing behind observed head leader motion
metrics: speed RMSE versus backward position slopes

acceptance.followingSkill: The upper 95% percentile-bootstrap bound on mean paired per-episode position-RMSE difference must be strictly below zero against each baseline.
acceptance.queueSkill: The upper 95% percentile-bootstrap bound on mean paired per-platoon headway-MAE difference against the rigid-spacing baseline must be strictly below zero.
acceptance.uncertainty: 10000 resamples with seed 20261026. Episode/platoon, never time samples or individual followers, is the resampling unit. Dependence within the same observed road/session limits interpretation; intervals are exploratory conditional summaries.
acceptance.rationale: Zero paired loss improvement is a comparative predictive-skill null, avoiding invented absolute field-accuracy tolerances. Report absolute errors regardless. Passing supports only this conditional comparison, not broad empirical adequacy.

execution: Retain v1 outcomes unchanged as released development evidence. Keep physical acceleration, deceleration, reaction time and gap coefficients unchanged.
The site cap is 35 mph from independent FHWA documentation. Sensitivities are predeclared diagnostics, never a basis for selecting the best holdout cap.
Freeze protocol, executable and selection source before fresh API access. Seal raw responses, identity exclusions and selected episodes before any model predictions.

Following requires unchanged common section and no recorded intersection for the entire observation interval. Queue release is selected using observed head motion independently of follower prediction errors.
Do not widen sample-count or skill targets after execution. Record missing eligible cases as a data gate and numerical/engine failures separately.
Retain all raw queries, hashes, exclusions, profiles, baseline comparisons and offline replay. Inspected v2 outcomes become development data before another model revision.

A secondary sensitivity with an initial speed above that cap is explicitly outside its domain and not executed; retain the primary episode and its unchanged cohort. Primary initial speeds must satisfy the documented site cap.
protocol.claimBoundary: New, identity-disjoint observations in previously unopened first-session time windows. Conditional active-Link-physics component assessment with a documented site cap and restricted context; no autonomous network, signal-state or general empirical adequacy claim.

followingContext.interpretation: Leader-dominated midblock component scope. Does not infer signals or exclude indirect upstream/downstream traffic effects.

queueRelease.releaseDefinition: First annotated head-leader speed >0.2 m/s after a one-second stopped initialization prefix, with >=0.3 m observed head displacement during the next second. All three prefix fitted speeds remain <=0.2 m/s in absolute value.
queueRelease.endpoint: Ceil the last observed station crossing plus one second to the 0.1 s grid, with a minimum five seconds and maximum twenty. Require complete common coverage through that endpoint. Missing predicted crossings fail coverage. Do not extend a failed prediction horizon.
queueRelease.station: 5 m beyond the observed head front at the last initialization sample; physical station and identities shared by all comparisons.
queueRelease.interpretation: Conditional queue-release response to observed head motion, not reconstruction of the green phase or saturated signal capacity.

followingVsConstantVelocity.interpretation: Exploratory conditional episode bootstrap; temporal dependence remains.

followingVsRigidSpacing.interpretation: Exploratory conditional episode bootstrap; temporal dependence remains.

queueHeadwaysVsRigidSpacing.interpretation: Exploratory conditional episode bootstrap; temporal dependence remains.

assessment.claimBoundary: New, identity-disjoint observations in previously unopened first-session time windows. Conditional active-Link-physics component assessment with a documented site cap and restricted context; no autonomous network, signal-state or general empirical adequacy claim.

interpretation: The frozen v2 gates determine the prospective result. V1 cap sensitivities remain released development diagnostics, never fresh acceptance. Conditional longitudinal following/queue-release evidence with observed head motion; signal phases and autonomous network validity remain unestablished.
